snippet.title: Hordeguard: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618000/

Hordeguard combines tower defense, action-strategy, and RPG genres, set in a Viking-inspired world.

Gather resources, fortify your village, recruit your warband, and defend against waves of monsters. With the clock ticking, every decision counts – strategize quickly and act swiftly to ensure the survival of your village. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode.

Web: https://blackdeergames.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/hDs9AH6
